d: A vintage-style portable radio with a sage green glossy casing, featuring a silver telescopic antenna and a prominent circular tuning dial on the front with gold accents and cryptic markings. The device is adorned with a single blue flower with a dark center and long, deep green leaves that wrap around the top and side. A thin gold metallic band wraps around the lower chassis, supported by small black feet at the base. BODY COLOR: sage green
